roommates = []

page_limit = 20
while True:
    res = apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=phone_token, query='', relationship='roommate', page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    contacts = res['success'] if isinstance(res, dict) and 'success' in res else res
    if not contacts:
        break
    roommates.extend(contacts)
    if len(contacts) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1
